title: In-flight refueling of the OXCART (CIA OXCART history, p. 288)
description: Dark photograph showing the OXCART aircraft in flight positioned behind a tanker aircraft during aerial refueling. The caption reads "In-flight refueling of the OXCART." Accompanying text covers project management changes and the section "OXCART'S FIRST FLIGHTS," describing the prototype's first flights in April 1962.
